AUTHOR: Villon
TITLE: A Deep learning method for accurate and fast identification of coral reef fishes in underwater images
REGION: Mayotte, Mozambique Channel, Western Indian Ocean (50 reef sites)
SPECIES: 20 common coral reef fish species from 12 families (e.g., Abudefduf sparoides, Chaetodon trifascialis, Naso elegans, Pomacentrus sulfureus, Zebrasoma scopas)
DATA: Own GoPro stationary video, 116 videos (25 h), 450,000 frames at 5 fps; training 44,625 thumbnails (T0), test 4,405 thumbnails from 6 videos; 1,197-thumbnail human-vs-CNN subset
V_EV: Sec 2.1: 'over 50 reef sites around the Mayotte island ... and at depth from 1 to 25 m' ... 'no artificial light or filter were used.'
D2: Train: T0 44,625 thumbnails (augmented to ~900,000); test: 4,405 thumbnails from 6 separate videos
D_EV: Sec 2.1: 'the test dataset was built using 6 videos recorded in contexts different from those of videos used for training (i.e. sites or days not included in the training database).'
R_EV: Sec 2.1: test set from '6 videos recorded in contexts different from those of videos used for training (i.e. sites or days not included...)' - same Mayotte 2015 campaign
C_EV: Sec 2.4: 'when the first proposition of the network was ‘environment’ with a confidence lower than 99% we provide, as final output, the fish class with the highest probability.'
E_EV: Sec 3.2: 'Mean rate of correct classification for humans was of 89.3% ... Rate of correct classification achieved by the best model on the same thumbnails was of 94.9%' (identification accuracy only)
ARCH: GoogLeNet (Caffe), trained from scratch; post-hoc decision rules r1/r2
METR: Correct identification (success) rate per species, confusion matrix, time per identification; human vs CNN comparison
NOTE: D1: test videos differ by 'sites or days' (mixed); coded 조사일, could equally be 사이트/서식지 (both give D_ALL=Y). Per P2, same 2015 Mayotte campaign -> R1=N. V: depth 1-25 m and natural light (no artificial light) reported; Fig. 2 notes CNN better on 'smaller or blurrier thumbnails' (qualitative, not visibility strata) -> V6=N. C: pure classification of pre-cropped thumbnails but uses a 99% confidence decision rule -> per policy C1=Y alone -> C_ALL=P; 98% certainty human-check workflow only proposed in Discussion. 'Environment' class is a background class, not an open-set/reject mechanism (C4=N). E: human-vs-CNN comparison is of species identification accuracy, not an ecological variable -> E1=없음. NIMG = 44,625 train + 4,405 test thumbnails. PLAT: cameras 'remained stationary' (metadata says DOV).
